Author: Wayne Tang
Name: WorkBuddy
Description: Control WorkBuddy with keys and dials: launch the client, draft tasks, switch models, read chats and credits, and manage the current session through local CDP.
Overview: Launch WorkBuddy, draft tasks, choose models and see live task status.

Actions.Name: New Task
Actions.Tooltip: Open a WorkBuddy task with a prefilled draft (you confirm before sending)

Actions.Name: Open Page
Actions.Tooltip: Jump to a WorkBuddy page: tasks, projects, skills, connectors and more Page availability depends on client version and enabled features.

Actions.Name: Open Conversation
Actions.Tooltip: Select a loaded WorkBuddy conversation from the dropdown, then press to open it. CDP is required to load the list.

Actions.Name: Model Switch
Actions.Tooltip: Turn the dial to switch models in WorkBuddy

Detail:
Install WorkBuddy Desktop. Drag Launch WorkBuddy onto a key. The inspector checks the client, status sync and current state.
Click Restart WorkBuddy to launch the client with CDP enabled.
Restarting WorkBuddy on Windows ends its processes and may interrupt active tasks. Save your work first.

New Task: Open a task with a prefilled draft. Review before sending.
Open Page: Open a WorkBuddy page. Available pages depend on the client version and enabled features.
Model Switch: Turn the dial to switch the model in the WorkBuddy composer.
Recent Task 1: Show a recent chat via CDP. Press to open it.
Recent Task 2: Show a recent chat via CDP. Press to open it.
Recent Task 3: Show a recent chat via CDP. Press to open it.
Recent Task 4: Show a recent chat via CDP. Press to open it.
Recent Task 5: Show a recent chat via CDP. Press to open it.
Switch Theme: Apply this key's theme. Press again to restore the default.
Current Session Status: Turn to choose an approval or question option, then press. For multiple choices, select options and then Submit. Requires CDP.
Voice Input: Start or finish voice input in WorkBuddy.
Send Message: Send the current draft, or stop the current response when Stop is shown.
Launch WorkBuddy: Start WorkBuddy with local CDP; when connected, bring its window forward.
Credit Balance: Show remaining account credits. Turn the dial to view recent-task usage (1–5). Press to refresh.

Set a prompt template with {clipboard}, {date} and {time}, plus directory, expert, skills, connectors and model. Maximum 8000 characters.

Open Conversation: Select a conversation loaded by WorkBuddy, ordered by recent activity. The key keeps this conversation when the recent list changes. Refreshing the list requires CDP; opening a saved selection uses its deep link.
